add_rewards_invoked_with_reentrant_token.meaning: addRewards is invoked with a token whose transferFrom can re-enter the Distributor

reentrancy_guard_absent.meaning: addRewards and claimRewards lack a nonReentrant guard and transferFrom is not ordered before bookkeeping

transfer_from_completed_before_bookkeepi.meaning: the external transferFrom completes before reward accounting is updated in addRewards
transfer_from_completed_before_bookkeepi.checkpoint: after addRewards external transferFrom, before reward accounting update

monetary_extraction_occurred.meaning: in some scenarios, monetary extraction occurs
monetary_extraction_occurred.checkpoint: after addRewards and reentrant claimRewards execution

assumptions: The external transferFrom is the only external call relevant to the ordering obligation.
Reward accounting update is the bookkeeping step referenced by the intent.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the attacker is an authorized caller of addRewards or claimRewards, so the actor/authorization qualifier of the scenario cannot be bound.
Report does not specify concrete amounts or numeric bounds for the accounting increase, so monetary extraction magnitude cannot be quantified.

Monetary extraction is described only as conditional ('in some scenarios') with no concrete observable relation, so the impact is represented as a grounded occurrence Boolean rather than a quantified value relation.

limitations: The impact is potential/conditional; the plan does not assert extraction as inevitable.
Ordering obligation is represented as a Boolean completion-before-bookkeeping observable rather than a full temporal trace.
No numeric magnitudes for extraction are available in the report.
